clips.title: The story
paras: On Thunder Bluff’s high mesas, Lieutenant Lisande watches for signs of the Scourge.

Lieutenant Lisande serves the Argent Dawn from Thunder Bluff, where human faces are rare. The holy order watches for signs of the Lich King's taint, even in remote Kalimdor. When undead forces stir on the plains below, Lisande calls on Horde champions to ride out and investigate before the Scourge can defile the sacred earth.
